name: Wood Pickaxe
art: Existing concept, keep. Pale birch handle with leaf carvings, cream-white curved head, butter-yellow bow, mint ribbon spiral, acorn charm, flower pommel. Ornament 1: the plain baseline of the set.

name: Stone Pickaxe
art: Existing concept, keep. Lilac-grey Rootflint stone head with a soft pearly sheen, birch handle, lilac ribbon cross-wraps, buckle bow, pebble charm, stone pommel. Ornament 1.

name: Copper Pickaxe
art: Apricot-peach (#F5B48A, from Kobold-copper) with cream and mint; motif: a kobold's tiny lantern; smooth hammered copper arms with soft dimples; birch handle with two copper bands; apricot satin bow, rosy gem in the collar, one tiny lantern charm. Ornament 2. Key to Titan's Rest.

name: Bog-Iron Pickaxe
art: Warm grey-lilac iron (#B9AAA4) with terracotta pink (#EBA58E, Titan clay); motif: moss and a sprouting mushroom; chunky rounded iron arms with puffy rivets; wood handle with a clay-pink wrap; terracotta bow, a little mushroom sprouting on the collar, one clay bead charm. Ornament 2.

name: Rune-Tin Pickaxe
art: Pale silver-cream tin (#E6E6DC) with powder-blue rune glow (#B4CCF2); motif: rounded cute runes and a giant's footprint; polished tin arms engraved with softly glowing runes (the first pick that glows); pale wood handle with silver bands and a blue ribbon spiral; sky-blue bow, round moonstone in the collar, two charms (rune tile, silver bell). Ornament 3. Key to Glitterhall.

name: Amethyst Pickaxe
art: Lilac amethyst (#C9A6E8) with lavender ribbons and gold accents; motif: a bard's music notes and a crystal cluster; faceted amethyst crystal arms; lilac-wrapped handle with thin gold bands; lilac bow, an amethyst point rising from the collar, two charms (gold music note, mini crystal), a few sparkles. Ornament 3.

name: Sapphire Pickaxe
art: Cornflower blue (#9CC4FF) with silver and white; motif: a Valkyrie feather and a round shield; clear faceted sapphire arms with silver edges; silver-capped handle with a blue satin spiral; white-blue bow, two small feathers hugging the collar (a quiet nod to Silver Wing), round sapphire in the collar, two charms (shield, star drop). Ornament 4. Key to Muspell.

name: Fireglass Pickaxe
art: Smoky rose glass (#B38AA3) with a warm peach ember inside (#FFAE96); motif: an ember asleep in glass, curls of steam; translucent glass arms with the ember glowing through; dark cherry-wood handle with rose-gold bands; coral bow, three charms (glass flame drop, ember bead, rose-gold ring), soft steam swirls. Ornament 4.

name: Ruby Pickaxe
art: Strawberry pink-red (#F57A8C) with rose gold and cream; motif: a little flame shaped like a heart; faceted ruby arms; rose-gold handle with a pink satin spiral; big pink bow with long tails, heart-cut ruby in the collar (foreshadows Royal Heart), three charms (flame, heart, gold bead), tiny ember sparkles. Ornament 5. Key to Mimir's Well.

name: Coral Pickaxe
art: Coral pink (#F7A6B5) with aqua (#8ED6D6) and pearl white; motif: coral branches, seashells, bubbles; arms sculpted as smooth coral branches that still read as a pick; pearly white handle with an aqua ribbon; a seashell in the collar, three charms (shell, pearl, bubble), bubbles floating round the head. Ornament 5.

name: Fatestone Pickaxe
art: Moonlit white-silver (#EEF2F8) with teal (#7CC6CC) and soft gold; motif: the Norns' three threads and a spindle; milky white stone arms wrapped by one golden thread; silver handle with three twined ribbons (white, teal, gold); spindle-shaped collar, three charms on fine chains (tiny hourglass, star, pearl), faint glowing thread lines. Ornament 6. Key to Alfglow.

name: Jade Pickaxe
art: Mint jade (#A8EBA0) with glowcap lilac (#B79BD8); motif: elf leaves, glowing mushrooms, fireflies; leaf-shaped translucent jade arms; plum wood handle wrapped in a mint vine with tiny leaves; leaf bow, a glowing mushroom cap on the collar, an elf-lantern charm plus two more, fireflies drifting round it. Ornament 6.

name: Opal Pickaxe
art: Iridescent opal pink (#F7B4E6) with rainbow flecks and lilac; motif: spore lights and a moth; opal crystal arms that shift colour as they turn; lilac handle with opal bead inlays and long ribbon tails; moth-wing bow, three chains of glowing spore orbs, a few spores floating round the head. Ornament 7. Key to the Great Gap.

name: Voidcrystal Pickaxe
art: Magenta-violet (#D88BE8) with deep plum and starry specks; motif: a pocket of void with tiny stars (foreshadows Galaxy); magenta crystal arms with little stars inside; dark plum handle with silver star studs; violet bow, a chain of four charms (star, crescent, crystal drop, bead), one small crystal orbiting the head. Ornament 7, and no wings, crowns, planets or big flower heads: those stay with the sky set.

name: Starlight Pickaxe
art: Existing concept and render (blender/out/pick_02), keep. Magenta-pink star crystal flower in a thin gold ring, tall crystal spike, twisted purple-magenta spiral handle with gold bands, pink star pommel. Sky set, ornament 8.

name: Moonlit Pickaxe
art: Existing concept and render (blender/out/pick_03), keep. Silver-blue crescent arms with white flowers and crystals, twisted silver handle, chains with crescent and crystal charms, flowing white ribbon. Sky set, ornament 8.

name: Galaxy Pickaxe
art: Existing concept and render (blender/out/pick_06), keep. Nebula arms full of stars, planet-orb gems set along a dark handle, star chains. Sky set, ornament 9.

name: Royal Heart Pickaxe
art: Existing concept and render (blender/out/pick_09), keep. Silver crown holding a big faceted pink heart gem, small diamonds and pink crystals, pink satin ribbon round a silver handle. Sky set, ornament 9.

name: Silver Wing Pickaxe
art: Existing concept and render (blender/out/pick_10), keep. Silver angel wings round a round blue sapphire with a small crown, translucent blue ribbons, silver chains with crystal drops, long slim silver handle. Sky set, ornament 10: the most magical pick in the game.
